RegistryConfig.description: Placement of `registry:` items, which follow the `registry-item.json` format.

aliases.description: Import aliases; unset ones use their defaults.

css.description: Stylesheet that items' CSS variables go into, e.g. `src/app/globals.css`.

namespaces.description: Item URLs by namespace, e.g. `"@acme": "https://acme.dev/r/{name}.json"`, so `registry:@acme/card` works.

server_components.description: Keep `"use client"` directives, for projects with React Server Components.

RelPath.description: Relative path with `/` separators; no `.`, `..` or absolute paths.

Value.description: A value given to a piece input.

description: Project settings in `cuilo.json` or `cuilo.toml`, committed with the project.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor completion.

paths.description: Output folder per piece, replacing the piece's target.

registry.description: Where `registry:` items go and how their imports read.

sources.description: Pack namespaces, e.g. `"@acme": "gh:acme/packs@v1.2.0"`, so `@acme/ui` names a pack in it.

stack.description:
Stack facts that replace detection, e.g. `framework = ["svelte"]`. `import_style` takes one of
`imports-extensionless` (`./foo`), `imports-js` (`./foo.js`) or `imports-ts` (`./foo.ts`) and sets how
generated JavaScript and TypeScript write relative imports, e.g. `import_style = ["imports-js"]`;
without it, the `tsconfig.json` that governs each piece's folder decides.

verify.description: Commands `--verify` runs instead of the detected checks, e.g. `[["bun", "run", "check"]]`; trusted projects only.

title: ProjectConfig
